TRIAGE OF THE OPHYD-SERVICE FORK REPORT, 2026-08-31. Environment stated by the reporter and checked: reflow2 0.45.0, claude-code 2.1.251, MCP 2025-11-25, read off `.reflow2/graph.client.json` in their own repo. CURRENT BINARY — these findings are live.

📌 NOT AN APPEND. Checked against `art:ophyd-service-feedback-2026-08-19` with a strict-prefix diff: 120 lines against 172, different content. A fresh document, not a running log — unlike dev_storyflow's, whose older copies ARE strict prefixes. The identity was read off the file, not off a note about it.

═══ ⭐⭐ ① THE HEADLINE ASK IS NOT A NEW GAP. IT IS A DEFERRED BRANCH WHOSE STATED REOPENING CONDITION IS NOW MET. ═══
`dec:parallel-alternatives` (ACCEPTED 2026-07-22, Anthony's word, both axes the recommended option) settles that AoA alternatives are BRANCH-BY-FILE rather than world-tagged inside one live graph. Its closing line names exactly what ophyd is asking for:

    "Deferred: the decision-point pointer nodes + collapse wiring (rung 2),
     WORLD-SCOPING IF SIMULTANEOUS IN-GRAPH AoA PROVES NEEDED, and
     per-branch readiness scoring (BL-68)."

And its reasoning against world-scoping was explicitly conditional: it "would bake world-awareness into every detector (possible_duplicate, allocation, SPOF, ...) — a large invasive change for a simultaneous-in-one-graph benefit NOT YET NEEDED, and BL-70 says branch-by-file 'teaches what the real scoping primitive must preserve' first."

⇒ OPHYD IS THE FIELD EVIDENCE THAT DECISION SAID WOULD REOPEN IT, and it arrives with a cost rather than a preference: a real architecture question (service consolidation) is PARKED — recorded as prose-level ideas, code branch created and idle — because modelling it properly would damage the main design's signals. Their sentence is the one worth keeping: "the tool's own strength (the health machinery) is what makes the workaround unacceptable."

⚠️ WHAT THAT DOES NOT SETTLE: whether branch-by-file has yet taught what the scoping primitive must preserve, which was the stated precondition. One report is evidence of need, not evidence that the lesson has been learned.

═══ 🛑 ② THEIR ITEM 4 IS NOW THE THIRD FIELD REPORT ON ONE RULE, AND THEY DISAGREE ═══
Ophyd objects that a CONTRADICTS from an exploratory idea to an accepted Decision lands in the main design's defect count — measured, 1 to 2 — and reads as damage rather than as a live exploration.

BUT `proj:bhome`, reporting the SAME DAY on the SAME behaviour, called it CORRECT: "Two were between brainstormed ideas and were correctly suppressed... The third involves a real requirement and was correctly surfaced. Nothing told me that distinction existed; the tool just got it right."

And heal.rs:1812-1825 records a PRIOR conflict with hxm_program (2026-08-26) resolved the same way, in a comment: "Against settled design, one parked side still leaves a live question." Suppression requires BOTH sides parked; one parked side against settled design still reports.

⇒ THREE REPORTS, TWO POSITIONS, ON A RULE WHOSE REASONING IS ALREADY WRITTEN DOWN. This is not a defect to fix; it is a disagreement to decide, and none of the three reporters knows about the other two.

═══ ⭐ ③ BUT OPHYD'S PROPOSED DISCRIMINATOR IS BETTER THAN ANYTHING AVAILABLE WHEN THAT RULE WAS WRITTEN — AND IT IS 2% POPULATED ═══
They suggest keying on "a CONTRADICTS whose source is an OPEN `kind: exploratory` Decision". MEASURED: `is_parked_idea` (heal.rs:2009) keys on `status == "proposed"` and NOTHING ELSE — which cannot tell an IDEA being turned over from a CHOICE somebody faced and has not settled. `kind` is exactly that discrimination and did not exist when the rule was written.

🛑 AND IT WOULD REACH ALMOST NOTHING TODAY: 12 of 584 Decisions carry `kind`; 572 do not. The only computation that reads `Decision.kind` is `linking_report` in relate.rs — a REPORT, not a detector. (detect.rs:4935 reads `Verification.kind`, a different property.)

⇒ SIXTH INSTANCE TODAY OF THE SAME SHAPE: a typed distinction built, an instruction that sets it (the brainstorm skill passes it), and NO DETECTOR READING IT. The fix is right in shape and would be near-inert until `kind` is populated — which is itself the argument the brainstorm skill's own honest-limits section anticipated when it said the graph had no brainstorm kind and that whether the distinction should become vocabulary 'turns on whether any computation would read it'.

═══ ⚠️ BOUNDS ═══
· One project, one session, one agent, and the agent is an LLM session rather than an independent user.
· The 1-to-2 defect measurement is on THEIR design, not reproduced here.
· Their `find_tools` check is reported, not verified by this triage — though it matches what `find_tools` returns here for the same shape of query.
· Whether world-scoping is the right answer is NOT established by any of this. What is established is that the accepted decision's own reopening condition has field evidence behind it for the first time.
